title: Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix on 1966-11-29
lineage: Transfer: Cassette > Tascam 122 MK3 > Korg MR2000S > DFF @5.6 MHz > Audiogate > wav 24/96. Lineage: wav 24/96 > iZotope RX8 Advanced
taper: This is Mark Cohen’s tape (Judy Lee’s brother) who worked for Electra records. It was given to Mark by Hail Milgraham, who was a colleague at Electra.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy ’60s show, praised for its vivid performance and audio clarity.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the energetic vibe of this mid‑60s concert and describe the recording as “audio history at its finest.” The soundboard source delivers crystal‑clear detail, making the band’s on‑point playing shine through. Overall the set is celebrated for its lively feel rather than specific song highlights.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (4‑5 stars) and highlight both performance energy and superior audio quality; with limited detail the rating is high but confidence remains medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as “audio history at its finest,” indicating a crisp, clear soundboard capture with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Listeners comment on the overall energy and tight performance of the night rather than specific set‑by‑set analysis.
